reproduction_assumptions: This profile-guided communication-frequency extension is non-formal and not paper-equivalent.
Per-core weights are derived from the final completed R1 shared-L2 demandAccesses requestor counters; no R1 rerun is required.
The weighted mean is used consistently in equation (15) and R2, but gem5 still receives one scalar shared-L2XBar latency rather than independent per-core latencies.
Communication frequency is not claimed to equal causal IPC sensitivity.
Alpha, beta, and cross-tier weight are non-formal values from the preserved raw-power P1 report.
Lambda_wire=0.0020119160767721133 is the FFT-local measured matched-R2 candidate and is rejected for formal or shared promotion.
McPAT uses direct gem5 O3 counters; its reported dynamic and leakage powers are consumed without post-processing multipliers.
Cache delay, area, and aspect-ratio-preserving geometry come only from the local CACTI run; no published cache table values are used.
The 8.72 effective local stack-resistance factor came from an earlier Table III temperature anchor and should be recalibrated after local-CACTI geometry changes.
